Definition: from G1909 and G4648; to oversee; by implication, to beware:--look diligently, take the oversight.
BiblicalUsage: Episkopeo means to oversee, to look diligently — to take the oversight. Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you; and feed the flock of God which is among you, taking the oversight thereof, not by constraint, but willingly.
TheologicalSignificance: Bitterness springs up quietly, and the overseer's eye must catch it early, because oversight is watching for roots, not only for wolves.
